description:
Post-event impact layers for Hurricane Melissa in Jamaica, mirrored from two datasets on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. (1) Building damage predicted by the Microsoft AI for Good Lab damage-assessment AI models on Vantor (formerly Maxar) satellite imagery of 29 and 31 October 2025 and NOAA NGS aerial imagery of 1 and 2 November 2025 over western Jamaica, published here only as counts aggregated to H3 resolution-9 cells and to parishes, never as individual footprints. (2) Road blockage and damage points identified by Planetary Response Network volunteers on Zooniverse from PlanetScope imagery, for Jamaica and Haiti. Every damage figure is a model or crowd prediction from overhead imagery, not a ground assessment, and the absence of a detection where imagery was cloudy or not flown is not evidence of no damage. Retrieved 2026-09-23. Definitions, measured totals, quirks and tested queries are in the generated AGENTS.md of each Collection.

**Disclaimer:** a demonstration of Portolan as cloud-native infrastructure for disseminating open geodatasets. This catalog republishes data from its original publishers in cloud-native formats such as GeoParquet and PMTiles, with STAC metadata — open, standards-based and freely accessible to everyone. It is not an official service of the original publishers, which remain the authoritative source.
